verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's docs explicitly claim AI-powered features that 'write... test cases automatically' alongside payload generation and pre-request scripting, directly supporting AI-generated assertions/test cases for a request. However, evidence doesn't show this is spec-driven (e.g., generating tests from an OpenAPI spec or from actual response data) or independently verified/hands-on confirmed by the community. Missing for 10: evidence of generating tests specifically from an API spec or from response inspection, independent/hands-on confirmation of quality, and detail on how comprehensive the generated assertions are.
